book.name: Lucas
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Lucas

content: To Pag-anak ki Jesus
To diya no panahon, migsugu si Hari Augusto no ipanglista to mgo ngadan to tibo ginsakupan din.
Seini to una no pagpanglista no si Cirenio to gubernadur to Siria.
Kaling kada sobuuk mig-andiya to yunsud no napuunan din su ogpalista.
Na, si Jose no mig-ugpa diya to Nazaret no sakup to Galilea mig-andiya to Betlehem no yunsud ni Hari David no sakup to Judea, su kaliwat man sikandin ni David.
Pigduma din si Maria no magkabodos on no pig-asawa din di wada pad hulidi.
Kabuyanan on ni Maria no diyad sikandan to Betlehem.
Ing-anak din to yukos no panganoy din. Pigtongos din to panapton aw pahibata duon to bohuganan to mgo buhi su wadad man lugar duon to paabutanan.
To Pagnangon to Anghil to mgo Magbantajay to Karneru
Na, duon to dani to Betlehem meyduon namanbantoy to mgo karneru to sikan no kadukiloman.
Puli nakatokow meyduon anghil to Ginuu no migyogwa duon kandan, aw katang-awi sikandan to kasiga to Ginuu. Pigdaitan sikandan,
di mig-ikagi sikan anghil, “Kona kow ogkahaedok, su meyduon madojow no ignangon ku iyu no igkalipay to tibo kaotawan.
Ing-anak kuntoon duon to yunsud ni David to Manyuyuwas now. Sikandin to Ginuu no ogpaharion to Diyus to kaotawan din!
Ogkamaanan now no matuud seini pig-ikagi ku, su ogkitaon now sikan bata no pigtongos to panapton aw pahibata duon to bohuganan to mgo buhi.”
Puli nakatokow nahimun to mahan-in hilabi no mgo anghil no napuun to yangit no migsaja to Diyus. Mig-iling sikandan,

content.text: Aw duon to pasak, igbogoy din to kalinow to mgo otow no ogmadojawan din.”

content: Pagkalius on to sikan mgo anghil pailing diya to yangit, migpaiikagihay sikan mgo magbantajay to karneru, “Og-andiya kinow on to Betlehem, su og-ahaon ta sikan impamaan to Ginuu ita.”
Dajun sikandan padagas diya to Betlehem. Pagtidow dan, nakitaan dan si Maria, si Jose dow sikan bata no pigpahibat duon to bohuganan.
Pagkatapus, ingnawnangon dan to diya pig-ikagi to anghil bahin to sikan bata.
Natingaya to tibo mgo otow no nakadinog to sikan kagi dan.

Naman-uli sikan mgo magbantajay to karneru no namansaja to Diyus tongod to sikan pigkita dan aw pigdinog no angod da to pig-ikagi to diya anghil. Di si Maria, puli din pighipidan sikan tibo duon to ginhawa din, aw kanunoy din pigdomdom.

Anoy man no nawayuhan on no aedow to pag-anak ki Jesus, pigtuman to mgo ginikanan din to tumanon to pagtuli. Pigngadanan dan sikandin ki Jesus, su sikan to pig-ikagi to diya anghil no wada pad sikandin ipangidam.
To Pagdae ki Jesus diya to Bayoy to Diyus

Na, no panahon on no ogtumanon to paghinlu to nanganak no insugu to balaod ni Moises, mig-andiya onsi Jose to Bayoy to Diyus diya to siyudad to Jerusalem. Oghalad sikandan duon su nasuyat duon to sikan balaod to Ginuu no pig-iling, “Ihalad now to Diyus to songo paris no limukon ubin songo paris no salapati no maintok pad.”
Pigdaya dan sikan bata su igpaabin dan to Diyus, su pigsuyat isab duon to balaod to Ginuu no pig-iling, “To bata no yukos no panganoy, igpaabin to Diyus.”
Na, meyduon matarong no otow no diyusnon diya to Jerusalem no iyan ngadan si Simeon. Migpaabut sikandin to kayuwasan to mgo kaliwat ni Israel, aw pigdumahan sikandin to Ispiritu Santu.
Tahan on sikandin pigpasabut to Ispiritu Santu no ayha sikandin ogkamatoy ko maaha din on to diya Insaad no Manyuyuwas no ogpaandinihon to Diyus.
Na, si Simeon no pigmanduan to Ispiritu Santu migsed duon to Bayoy to Diyus. Pagdaeha to sikan bata no si Jesus to mgo ginikanan din no ogtuman to mgo tumanon,
pigsakupu ni Simeon sikan bata. Dajun din sajaa to Diyus. Kagi din,

content.text: “Kuntoon Ginuu ku no Magboboot to tibo, inggad mamatoy ad,
su natuman on seini insaad nu kanay.
no pighinaat nu no maaha to tibo kaotawan.
Sikandin to soga no ogtang-ow to mgo otow no kona no Hibru.
Aw ogbajawon koy isab no mgo Hibru no kaotawan nu,
su seini Manyuyuwas iyan kasiga noy.”

content: Natingaya to ginikanan ni Jesus to sikan pig-ikagi ni Simeon bahin to sikan bata.
Dajun ampu si Simeon no madojawan sikandan to Diyus. Pagkatapus, pig-ikagihan din si Maria, “Pigbootan to Diyus no seini no bata iyan ogpakailing to pagkabahin ta no mgo kaliwat ni Israel.
To ogpasakup kandin, ogkayuwas. Di to ogsupak, ogkastiguhon to Diyus. Ogkakiyayahan no pigsugu sikandin to Diyus, di mahan-in to ogsupak kandin.
Kaling ogyagbasan to ginhawa nu to kaguul angod to mahait no ispada. Aw pinaagi kandin ogkamaanan to hona-hona to mahan-in no mgo otow.”

Na, duon to Jerusalem meyduon isab bujag no kawayuan on mey-upat no tuig to idad no kibali ba-ba to Diyus. Iyan ngadan din si Ana no anak ni Panuel no kaliwat ni Aser. Pitu da no tuig to kaminyoon din,
nabayu on sikandin. Migpakamonang on duon to Bayoy to Diyus. Aedow dow madukilom ogsimba dow og-ampu aw ogpuasa.

Na, sikan no uras no duon pad onsi Jose to Bayoy to Diyus, migduguk si Ana. Migpasalamat sikandin to Diyus aw ingnawnangon din sikan bata duon to mgo otow no migtatagad to pagyuwas to Diyus kandan no mgo Hibru.
Pagkatapus on to tibo tumanon no insugu to balaod to Ginuu, mig-uli si Jose dow si Maria diya to yunsud dan no Nazaret no sakup to Galilea.
Na, migtulin sikan bata no madoson dow maalamon, aw pinadajag sikandin to Diyus.
To Pagpabilin ni Jesus diya to Bayoy to Diyus
Kada tuig og-andiya to mgo ginikanan ni Jesus to siyudad to Jerusalem su ogtambung to Pista to Pagyaboy.
Na, pag-idad ni Jesus to sampuyu-tag-duwa, pigpaduma dan sikandin.
Anoy man no natapus on to pista, mig-uli to mgo ginikanan ni Jesus no wada kamaan no migpabilin da naan sikandin diya to Jerusalem.

Nailing to boot dan no nakaduma si Jesus to kahan-inan no kadumahan dan no naman-uli, kaling migpadajun sikandan to pagpanow. Di pagkahapun to sikan no aedow no wada dan kitaa si Jesus, migsugud sikandan to pagpamangha kandin diya to mgo kadumahan dan.
Anoy man no wada dan kakita-i, migpauli sikandan diya to Jerusalem su diya dan ogpamanghaon.
Na, duon to ikatoyu no aedow, bali no nakitaan dan si Jesus no mig-ingkud duon to Bayoy to Diyus no migpagsakot to mgo maistru to tinuuhan. Naminog si Jesus kandan aw nangusip.
Tibo to migdinog kandin natingaya to pagpanabut dow pagpanabak din.

Natingaya isab to mgo ginikanan ni Jesus no makitaan dan sikandin. Kagi to inoy din, “Aduy Utu, nokoy no nakayangub ka man to paghinang to angod to seini kanami? Siak dow to amoy nu yagboy on nalimuut ikow. Nakaaw-andei koy on to pagpamangha!”
Kagi ni Jesus, “Nokoy no ogpamanghaon a now man? Wada kow kamaan no kinahangyan no dini a to bayoy to Amoy ku?”
Di wada dan kasabuti to kahuyugan to sikan kagi din.
Na, migduma si Jesus to mgo ginikanan din diya to Nazaret, aw masinuguton sikandin kandan. Di sikan tibo puli pighipidan ni Maria duon to ginhawa din.
Migtulin si Jesus no migdugang to kaalam din, aw to Diyus dow mgo otow nasajaan kandin.
